scope: Twenty-first bounded target-specific wave: eight current completion-unproved eMAR targets; three direct OpenEMR inventory recommendations and five conservative retained-unproved outcomes.

methodology.runtime_boundary: No application, browser, database, deployment or product Git state was changed.
methodology.no_copy_rule: Evidence is behavioural only; do not copy source, schema, UI, wording or distinctive layouts.
methodology.direct_rule: A recommendation requires target-specific neutral job alignment at pinned official community-source loci. Generic inventory primitives do not inherit controlled-drug, pharmacy-order or self-administration credit.
methodology.reuse_rule: Every cited source path has zero prior evidence-source path hits. Reuse within retained rows is explanatory only and no repository- or family-level inference is allowed.

OPENEMR.edition_boundary: Pinned official community source only; hosted services, private configuration and unpinned behavior are excluded.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Control medication inventory by location and lot with authorised receipt, transfer, adjustment and consumption actions plus bounded on-hand checks.
evaluations.research_candidate: openemr/openemr inventory service and drug-inventory surface at pinned loci
evaluations.reason: Authorised inventory roles view active lots and on-hand quantities by warehouse/facility and perform purchase, transfer, adjustment and consumption actions. Dispense validates a patient-bound encounter, excludes destroyed, empty and expired lots, rejects insufficient stock and persists lot/sale provenance. This does not infer controlled-drug, Site-policy, concurrency or runtime parity.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Record authorised medicine-lot destruction with date, method, witness and notes and expose a bounded destruction register.
evaluations.research_candidate: openemr/openemr lot-destruction command and destroyed-drugs report at pinned loci
evaluations.reason: Drug-admin authority plus CSRF gates a lot-destruction update retaining destruction date, method, witness and notes; a date-bounded register queries and displays destroyed lots and those provenance fields. This does not infer controlled-drug rules, independent witness authority, immutable audit or runtime parity.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Provide an authorised medication inventory-operations report with transaction categories, provenance filters and export.
evaluations.research_candidate: openemr/openemr inventory-transactions report at pinned locus
evaluations.reason: Report authority gates date-bounded inventory operations, filters sale, distribution, transfer and adjustment categories, joins transaction, product, lot, warehouse, patient, encounter and distributor provenance, and provides CSV export. This is an inventory-operations report only, not MAR-round or application-runtime proof.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Govern pharmacy-order authoring and state progression through supplier handoff, acknowledgement, dispense, delivery and failure recovery.
evaluations.research_candidate: openemr/openemr dispense and inventory sources at pinned loci
evaluations.reason: An ACL-gated dispense can link a supplied prescription to inventory and sale handling, but it does not establish pharmacy-order authoring, supplier acknowledgement, delivery state, failure/retry or a complete order lifecycle.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Maintain a legally attributable controlled-drug running balance with signed custody provenance.
evaluations.research_candidate: openemr/openemr generic lot and on-hand sources at pinned loci
evaluations.reason: Generic lots, on-hand quantities and insufficiency checks do not establish controlled-substance classification, a legal register, signed running balance or custody/witness provenance.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Investigate and close controlled-drug discrepancies with detected and explained quantities, accountable review and reopen provenance.
evaluations.research_candidate: openemr/openemr generic inventory adjustment and reporting sources at pinned loci
evaluations.reason: Generic inventory adjustments and transaction reporting do not create a discrepancy case, assigned investigation, reviewed explanation, closure or reopen lifecycle.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Record, classify and escalate a controlled-drug loss through immutable reporting and final decision provenance.
evaluations.research_candidate: openemr/openemr generic possible-destruction notification at pinned loci
evaluations.reason: Detection of expired or small lots and a generic possible-destruction email do not establish controlled-drug loss classification, authority, escalation, immutable report or final decision.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Assess and govern self-administration competency, risks, authorisation, review, expiry and revocation with eMAR enforcement.
evaluations.research_candidate: openemr/openemr patient medication-issue service at pinned locus
evaluations.reason: Generic patient medication-issue create/update can retain request intent, usage category and adherence source, but does not establish self-administration assessment, competency/risk evidence, authorisation, review, expiry, revocation or eMAR enforcement.
